spec_format.description: framework.yaml: spec_format as actually run. A list since Phase D added a third format and `both` stopped being meaningful.

source_ac_ids.description: Every AC/decision-table row id covered; must match across every rendered format, except that playwright legitimately omits the ids listed in omitted_scenarios.

omitted_scenarios.description: playwright only. Scenarios not rendered because behaviors/scenario-bindings.json says they are domain-only or not-observable — there is nothing a browser could assert. Each is reported by d1 as not_exercised with this reason, so the omission is counted rather than invisible.
